# Ymir Tool

Ymir Tool is a browser-based developer toolbox for JSON formatting, Base64 and URL encoding, JavaScript formatting, regular expressions, text comparison, text counting, and Unix timestamp conversion.

Website: https://ymirtool.com/
Guides: https://ymirtool.com/guides.html
About and maintenance method: https://ymirtool.com/about.html
Contact: https://ymirtool.com/contact.html

## Maintained tools

- https://ymirtool.com/json/
- https://ymirtool.com/base64/
- https://ymirtool.com/urlencode/
- https://ymirtool.com/formatjs/
- https://ymirtool.com/regex/
- https://ymirtool.com/textdiff/
- https://ymirtool.com/txtcount/
- https://ymirtool.com/unixtime/

## Boundaries

Use non-sensitive or redacted input. Verify important output in the target system. Base64 is encoding, not encryption. The site is not a security audit, legal, medical, financial, or engineering certification service.
